waves.name: Shared customer-area pair
waves.rationale: The whole tree is two 8-line programs that both COPY SHARED01. A layout change hits both, so they move as one unit. Nothing else in the tree is coupled to them, so a second wave would be invented.
waves.unblocks: A single target-language definition of SHARED-AREA, including the packed decimal SH-BALANCE, for any other program outside this tree that includes SHARED01.
